title: AGENTS.md
text: condathis R package designed simplify execution command-line interface (CLI) tools within isolated reproducible environments. package’s primary goal solve reproducibility dependency-conflict problems arise calling system tools R. achieves using micromamba create manage sandboxed Conda environments, allowing R users run CLI tool specific dependencies. Core Functionality: Create isolated Conda environments (create_env()). Run CLI commands within specified environment (run()). Manage environments installations within R. Key Technologies: Language: R (requires R ≥ 4.3) Core External Tool: micromamba (package already manages internally). processx: running managing external processes (like micromamba). withr: managing state environment variables execution. fs: file system operations. cli: creating rich command-line user interface, including error messages. Testing: testthat (≥ 3.0.0). Task Runner: just (justfile present repository).

title: Introduction to condathis
text: Running command-line (CLI) tools R can powerful way extend analysis, often comes challenges. ensure tool installed? manage dependencies without conflicting software system? make analysis reproducible others? condathis package designed solve problems. allows run CLI tool sandboxed, reproducible environment, powered micromamba. vignette provides brief introduction core functionality condathis.

title: Introduction to condathis
text: Imagine want analyze BAM file using samtools, popular bioinformatics tool. write R script calls samtools using system(), approach drawbacks: Dependency Hell: script depends samtools installed available system’s PATH. share script colleague, need install manually, might install different version, lead different results. Conflicts: Installing samtools dependencies might conflict tools already installed system. Reproducibility: ’s hard guarantee analysis run way different machines later time, software environment explicitly defined.

title: Create a Conda environment — create_env
text: packages Character vector package MatchSpec strings. Examples: "python=3.13", "bioconda::fastqc==0.12.1". Defaults NULL. env_file Character string path environment YAML file. Defaults NULL. provided, passed micromamba create -f. env_name Character string target environment name. Defaults "condathis-env". channels Character vector channel names used dependency resolution. Defaults c("conda-forge", "bioconda"). method Character string backend execution strategy. Supported values "native" "auto". Defaults "native". argument soft-deprecated currently change behavior. channel_priority Character string channel priority mode. Supported values "disabled", "strict", "flexible". Defaults "disabled". additional_channels Character vector additional channels appended channels. Defaults NULL. platform Character string platform used dependency solving (example, "linux-64", "osx-64", "osx-arm64", "win-64", "noarch"). Defaults NULL. Apple Silicon, condathis may fall back "osx-64" Rosetta 2 available packages available "osx-arm64". verbose Character string controlling console output. Supported values "output", "silent", "cmd", "spinner", "full". Defaults "output". Logical values accepted backward compatibility: TRUE maps "output" FALSE maps "silent". overwrite Logical value controls whether existing environment always recreated. Defaults FALSE.

title: Run a command inside a Conda environment — run
text: cmd Character string command execute. ... Additional unnamed command arguments passed cmd. env_name Character string target environment name. Defaults "condathis-env". default environment exist, created automatically. method Character string backend execution strategy. Supported values "native" "auto". Defaults "native". argument soft-deprecated currently change behavior. verbose Character string controlling console output. Supported values "output", "silent", "cmd", "spinner", "full". Defaults "output". Logical values accepted backward compatibility: TRUE maps "output" FALSE maps "silent". error Character string controls error behavior. Supported values "cancel" "continue". Defaults "cancel". stdout Standard output target. Defaults "|" (capture stdout returned object). Provide file path redirect stdout file. stderr Standard error target. Defaults "|" (capture stderr returned object). Provide file path redirect stderr file. stdin Standard input source. Defaults NULL (stdin stream). Provide file path use file contents stdin.
